cases.name: Beatrice "Wendy" Gonzalez
cases.about: Aunt Serena Salinas recalled how affectionate Priscilla and Beatrice were. “As soon as they got here they would always ask my mom and I if they could have a sleepover,” she said of the sisters who had a love of all things “Star Wars.” “They were so so lovable and would always tell you every five minutes how much they loved you.”
